## pan-p05 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Long dwelling-with and total grace received, yet repeated forgetting; the only request is no more absence.

*Rasa: karuṇa (compassion-plea) with śānta (tranquility of acceptance) — The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) in the mode of confession (vismara admitted); the vyabhicāri is forgetting, integrated into the plea for presence (stheyaṃ na bhūyas).*
